GORDON TRAINER’S NOTICE OF ERRORS IN APPLICANT’S PROPOSED ORDER OF PRESENTATION AND REQUEST FOR CORRECTION

INTRODUCTION
On June 3, 2026, Applicants filed their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 (Item No. 5755), attaching Attachment 2 a proposed order of presentation grouping intervenors by route segment. Gordon Trainer files this notice to identify an error in Attachment 2 that directly affects himself. Gordon Trainer requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct Applicants to correct Attachment 2.



ERRORS REQUIRING CORRECTION
Gordon Trainer is missing from the list of proposed intervenors. Gordon Trainer has been granted intervenor status and has submitted his testimony. Gordon Trainer requests the list to be updated with his corrected information.

Gordon Trainer (A6)
